title: The charcoal kitchen
description: A charcoal high-gloss kitchen with a working island, white stone-look tops and red-framed glass display cabinets, by Malepe R&R.
intro: A dark, reflective kitchen built around a working island: hob and oven set into the island, charcoal high-gloss doors and white stone-look worktops. A single run of red-framed glass display cabinets supplies the only colour.
body: Gloss this dark exposes every misaligned door and uneven gap, so the joinery has to be exact. Long bar handles run in one unbroken line across the base units, and the tall unit beside the window completes the composition.
The island carries its own cooking zone, so the room works as both kitchen and gathering place.

photos.caption: Display cabinets above the sink run

title: White gloss U-kitchen
description: A white high-gloss U-shaped kitchen photographed during installation and at handover, by Malepe R&R.
intro: Photographed twice: once with the window still under plastic, and again at handover. The same U-shaped run of white high-gloss doors and drawers, from fitted carcasses to a finished room.
body: White gloss is unforgiving in the opposite way: every scuff and fingerprint shows. The drawer bank beneath the window and the full-height units on the right are set out on the same lines as the ceiling.

title: White gloss kitchen with breakfast bar
description: A white high-gloss kitchen with built-in oven, tall units and a breakfast counter, from installation to handover, by Malepe R&R.
intro: Tall units frame a built-in oven and hob, with a breakfast counter returning into the room. During installation the shelving was still open and the floor covered in offcuts; at handover, stools sit at the counter.
body: Two photographs of the same room: the record of a job moving from carcass to finished kitchen.
